responsibility: This machine description file implements the Loongson MMI multimedia extension instructions in GCC’s MIPS backend. It defines the UNSPEC codes, vector mode iterators, move and initialization expanders, and the instruction patterns for Loongson SIMD-style pack, arithmetic, shuffle, unpack, whole-vector shift, extract, and reduction operations, mapping GCC RTL vector operations and builtins onto the Loongson-specific MMI instruction set.
